creator: Alexander Terp
description: With tab_then_pane the only scheme, the nine focus_pane_1..9 actions and the menu's Pane N titles name the Nth numbered chord, which is a tab first. Renaming them means refusing configs that name the old actions, as the focus_tab_N removal did.
title: 🎹 focus_pane_N and the Pane N menu titles misdescribe the chord
